newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bourse examines Globus options trade.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bourse examines Globus options trade.

text.p: The Swiss Exchange said it planned a routine investigation into trading in options for shares of retailer Magazine zum Globus before last week's news that rival Migros-Genossenschafts-Bund was offering to buy the company.
"We will certainly consider this case within the scope of normal activities," exchange spokesman Michael Staehlin said in response to an enquiry.

Swiss newspapers at the weekend reported that there was unusual activity in options on Globus participation certificates before Friday's announcement that Globus's pool shareholders and board accepted Migros' offer to buy 53.8 percent of the Globus voting capital or 28.6 percent of the capital.
Migros also said it was offering to buy all other outstanding shares at 1,180 Swiss francs per registered share and 1,080 francs per participation certificate.
Swiss bourse trading statistics show that some 91,600 call options on Globus participation certificates were traded on Thursday, July 3.
About 17,000 options were traded on the Wednesday prior, 13,600 on the Tuesday and 17,000 on the Monday.
Similarly high volumes exceeding 80,000 options were seen on June 19 and June 23.
A total of 500,000 Globus participation certificate options was issued by OZ Holding on June 13. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
